# crosswork_device_notification_policies (Data Source)

This data source can read a notification policy for device alarms and events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_device_notification_policies" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-dnp"
  name = "cwtest-dnp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the policy, unique on the Crosswork cluster (also against system policies). The controller accepts letters, digits, spaces and the characters `- . _ :`

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the policy. The controller accepts letters, digits, spaces, line breaks and the characters `, - . _ :`
- `device_group` (String) Id of the device group whose devices the policy applies to. Without it the policy applies to all devices
- `filters` (Attributes List) Filters of the alarms and events, an alarm or event is forwarded when it matches any filter. Each filter holds at least one of `severities`, `category` and `events`. A `category` needs `severities` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `syslog_receivers` (Attributes Set) Syslog receivers that get the notifications. A policy needs at least one trap or syslog receiver (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--syslog_receivers))
- `trap_receivers` (Attributes Set) Trap receivers that get the notifications. A policy needs at least one trap or syslog receiver (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trap_receivers))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the filter, one name. It needs `severities` and cannot hold a single quote or a backslash
- `events` (Set of String) Event types of the filter (the `eventTypeName` of the catalog). A value cannot hold a single quote or a backslash
- `severities` (Set of String) Severities of the filter, each one of `information`, `warning`, `minor`, `major` and `critical`


<a id="nestedatt--syslog_receivers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `syslog_receivers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the syslog receiver, as in `crosswork_syslog_destination`. It cannot hold a single quote or a backslash


<a id="nestedatt--trap_receivers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trap_receivers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the trap receiver, as in `crosswork_trap_destination`. It cannot hold a single quote or a backslash
